title.narrative: Education (80%), Child Protection Service Provision (10%) and basic assistance (10%) for Lebanese, Migrants, Syrian and Palestinian Refugees in North Lebanon

description.narrative:
ltpgtAl-Fayhaa Association(AFA) is willing to apply for a multi-sectoral program incorporating Education, Basic Assistance(BA),
Child Protection(CP) activities targeting Lebanese, migrants, Syrian other refugees in North Lebanon.lt/pgtltpgtAt the beginning, AFA will hold outreach activities targeting vulnerable children who will participate in the program’s different sectors. On top of that, AFA through different community engagement initiatives awareness sessions will fill in the vulnerability checklist to refer Out of School Children(OoSC) to Formal Education(FE), Non-Formal Education(NFE), protection or other needed services.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt Aiming to retain school children from dropping out, AFA will implement retention remedial homework support (RS) program targeting 440 children (60%Lebanese, 30%Syrian refugee 10%migrant/ Palestinian or other nationalities)in Tripoli governorate. In school children from Grade1 to 6 who have poor academic achievement at risk of dropping will get interactive learning support for 6 months in major subjects (Arabic, Foreign language, Math, Science, Social emotional learning(SEL) sessions).lt/pgtltpgt Moreover, AFA will be targeting 120 children, whose ages range between 8 and 14, who have either never been to school or has dropped out from at least two years with Basic Literacy and Numeracy (BLN) to retain accumulating learning losses, also aiming to get them back to formal education after finishing the required BLN cycles. This will be for a period of 4 months in Tripoli Governate.lt/pgtltpgt The program will be inclusive to children with disabilities (CWD), where CWD will be 50% of the targeted beneficiaries (280 child) 70 CWD (25% of CWD) will be supported through 16 therapy sessions each, in addition AFA will procure assistive devices such as hearing aids, wheel chairs to cases in need to facilitate retention in education, to 28 CWD (10% of CWD).lt/pgtltpgtIn addition, RS and BLN students will benefit from winterization kit through supplies or clothes during cold weather.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtFurthermore, an exam support program for 120 official exam candidates (grades 9 12), this activity will be complemented by the initiative that is being done by AFA from years, distributing Supplementary Exercises guides (ANNAL) for free in English French for Mathematics Sciences over 3 months in Tripoli Governate.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe RS program, the BLN program and the exam support program
will be reinforced by the distribution of teaching learning materials healthy snacks. Besides, the skills of facilitators will be reinforced particularly in CP, MHPSS, education methodologies while, the skills of caregivers will be strengthened.lt/pgtltpgtThe CP program focuses on girls, boys women who reside in marginalized areas, either refugees vulnerable Lebanese experiencing physical violence, abuse child labor in need for Case Management(CM), Focus Psychosocial Support(FPSS) Community Based Psychosocial Support(CBPSS).ltbrgtAFA will implement CM, for 20 cases of children involved in child labor street connected children in North.ltbrgtMoreover, AFA will provide CBPSS to 100 low medium cases of children at risk of child Labor, early marriage, or any other type of risks, this target will be divided to two age groups, aged(6-11) aged(12-17).ltbrgtTo establish the purpose of Multi-sectoral programs to provide a holistic approach to all the family. 50 caregivers will participate in positive parenting FPSS sessions to provide them with best parenting skills to deal protect children from possible risks.ltbrgtMoreover, AFA team will implement several community-initiatives related to Qudwa toolbox, engaging the community to find solutions raise awareness on Violence Against Children, Child Protection, Violence Against Women, Child Labor.ltbrgtlt/pgt
